_comment: THE ONLY DEFINITION OF A SHIP KIT (docs/ship-kit.md): what the Mac generates beside a demo so a builder
can post it, the captions a model may write for it, the request the phone makes for one, and what a
published kit may carry. scripts/gen_shipkit.py emits capture/shipkit/tables.py (standard library, the
(the door, Pydantic) and mobile/src/generated/shipkit.ts. Never hand-edit the output.
Frame sizes are NOT here: spec/devices.v1.json is the only place one lives, and the format ids below are
held to its `formats` by the generator.
A refusal is a code. Every code has its sentence in `refusals`, rendered on the Mac, the server and the
phone from the same table, so a kit that could not make its 16:9 video says the same words everywhere.

platform_limits._comment: Characters a caption may run to on each platform, as each documents it for a plain post from an ordinary account (2026-09): X 280 (a longer post needs a paid account), Bluesky 300, Threads 500, LinkedIn 3000, Instagram 2200, TikTok 2200 (the 4000 raise is not on every account). The thread variant is X posts of 280 each.

platform_format._comment: The format each platform's post shows best: the one the phone's Share selects first for it. Any format can be sent anywhere.

caps._comment: What one published kit may hold. Videos: one per format. Stills: the demo's own, at most 8, and each framed once. The App Store sets: at most 8 a slot. A GIF at most the device table's loop.max_bytes; a video at most the demo channel's 40 MiB; an image at most its 6 MiB.

refusals.device_aspect_mismatch: the device came out a different shape in this format than it is, so the format was not kept
refusals.blank_segment: part of the video shows a blank screen, so it was not kept
refusals.render_failed: this format could not be rendered
refusals.invented_number: the caption carried a number the session never gave, so it was dropped
refusals.names_a_repository: the caption named a repository, so it was dropped
refusals.over_limit: the caption ran past what the platform takes, so it was dropped
refusals.no_model: no caption could be written: claude is not on this Mac
refusals.loop_too_large: the GIF came out too large to paste anywhere, so there is none
refusals.aspect_too_far: the screenshots are not the shape the App Store asks for
refusals.no_ipad_capture: an iPad screenshot has to be filmed on an iPad: python -m capture demo --device ipad-pro-13 --no-video
refusals.not_an_ios_app: App Store screenshots are for an iOS app
refusals.no_previous_demo: there is no earlier demo to compare with yet
refusals.no_video: the demo has no video, so the kit has stills only
refusals.privacy_not_checked: the demo's privacy check did not pass, so no kit is made from it
refusals.not_runnable: this project could not be run on the Mac
refusals.capture_failed: the Mac could not film it
refusals.privacy_refused: the Mac found a name or a key on screen and kept the demo to itself
refusals.kit_failed: the demo was made, and the kit around it was not
refusals.no_checkout: the Mac has no checkout of this project
refusals.cancelled_on_mac: it was cancelled on the Mac
refusals.not_a_repository: the session did not run in a repository
refusals.nothing_shipped: the session committed nothing the app shows
refusals.not_demoable: the project is not something the Mac can run and film
refusals.already_filmed: the newest commit is already filmed
refusals.already_queued: a demo of it is already waiting

Caption.name: platform
Caption.doc: Which platform this post is written for.

Caption.name: text
Caption.doc: The post, as it will be pasted. Within the platform's own limit (platform_limits). Every number in it must be one of the numbers in the input, written the same way; no number the input does not have, no claim the input does not make, no hashtag soup (at most three, only where the platform uses them), no dash of any kind.

Caption.name: thread
Caption.doc: X only: the same story as a thread of 2 to 5 posts, each within 280 characters. Empty for every other platform.

ShareCopy.name: captions
ShareCopy.doc: One per platform: x, linkedin, threads, instagram, tiktok, bluesky.

KitCaption.name: text
KitCaption.doc: The caption, checked: every number is in the kit's inputs, no repository name, within the platform's limit.

KitCaption.name: source
KitCaption.doc: model: written by the person's own claude and checked; template: made from the inputs with no model, when the model's was dropped or there was none.

Refused.name: what
Refused.doc: What was refused: a format id, a platform, `loop`, an App Store slot.

KitPresign.name: publish_id
KitPresign.doc: A random id the Mac mints for one publish of a kit, so the server tells the new set from the one it replaces.

KitPresign.name: slot
KitPresign.doc: What the file is in the kit.

KitPresign.name: bytes
KitPresign.doc: 1-41943040: the file's size, what the upload must send exactly.

KitPresign.name: duration_ms
KitPresign.doc: 1-31000: a video's length. Null for an image or the GIF.

KitPresign.name: position
KitPresign.doc: 0-63: its place among the files of its slot.

KitPresign.name: label
KitPresign.doc: What a still shows, the demo's own label (the demo channel's label rule). Null for a video.

KitDocument.name: publish_id
KitDocument.doc: The publish its files were presigned under.

KitDocument.name: device
KitDocument.doc: The row of spec/devices.v1.json the demo was filmed on.

KitDocument.name: hue
KitDocument.doc: The project hue the formats are drawn in.

KitDocument.name: captions
KitDocument.doc: One per platform that has a caption.

KitDocument.name: changelog
KitDocument.doc: What changed since the last demo: commit subjects, newest first, as written. Never a commit hash.

KitDocument.name: refused
KitDocument.doc: What the kit could not make, each with its code.

DemoRequestIn.name: project_key
DemoRequestIn.doc: The project: the repository's salted hash, whole.

DemoRequestIn.name: hue
DemoRequestIn.doc: The hue the phone draws the project in, so the kit wears the same one.

DemoRequestFinish.name: status
DemoRequestFinish.doc: done or failed; nothing else finishes a request.

DemoRequestFinish.name: refusal
DemoRequestFinish.doc: Why it failed. Null when done.
